acceptance: Three consecutive certified bundles produce matching trees apart from the allowlist (run ids and digests recorded in context)
shadow-allowlist.json committed with a reason per entry
context: muse AR-20 (accepted in part): the allowlist is enumerated in a file. Dispatching core site-deploy in preview mode is allowed; mode=deploy is not. If a match cannot be reached after two fix attempts, record the diff and ask the owner.
description:
This item produces evidence in the tracker. Fix any mismatch in a small site PR; it may be stacked.

1. Set the core repo variable SITE_BRIDGE_ENABLED=true, so every certified bundle dispatches to the site.
2. For each certified bundle, compare the site build with a core `site-deploy.yml` preview (`-f mode=preview`) at the same core_sha. Use tree-digest.ts for the comparison.
3. Allowed differences live in `inventory/shadow-allowlist.json`, each with a reason. Only these are allowed:
   - the edit-link and GitHub source-link URL rewrites from site-split-22;
   - the receipt file;
   - files that embed those.
   Fix anything else.

Core site-deploy stays the production writer throughout. SITE_DEPLOY_TARGET stays unset in the site repo.
